﻿A very simple mod that makes obtaining hay a bit more realistic.

In ranching, you typically harvest a lot of grass and bale them, leaving them to dry in the sun, and then it produces hay. There are many ways to do it, but I did not like just being able to scythe hay out of fresh grass. Instead, you must place fiber into the haybales, and place them outside.

Soon the fiber will dry and the haybale will give you a decent amount of hay.

It is highly recommended to get a mod that prevents you from scything hay from grass, otherwise this mod doesn't make much sense.

I use [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/aedenthorn#CustomHay]Aedethorn's CustomHay unnofficial 1.6 update.[/url] And simply set the config to  "OrdinaryHayChance": 0.0,


This works with Automate as well, hope you enjoy and please let me know if there are issues.﻿[/center]
